name: manni
description: Checks the docs an agent edits against everything the repository set up in manni, blocks on errors, records the session manifest tracevals reads for a user who turns tracevals on, serves the docs graph to the agent, and hands the agent a page's metadata when it reads one.

tracevals.title: Judge each turn with tracevals
tracevals.description: Run manni's tracevals hooks for you. They record each session's manifest, fetch the judge model and judge each turn where the repository sets tracevals.runtime. Off unless you turn it on.
